feed.title: Open Tools and Research — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1286 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Grailed Fee Calculator — What You Keep After the New 6% / 9% Commission
entry.summary: Free Grailed seller fee calculator for the tiered commission (6% under $120 with a $1.99 minimum, 9% from $120) plus 3.49% + $0.49 payment processing. See your payout, profit, the price for a target profit, and the $120 step where the whole sale jumps to 9%. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: TCGplayer Fee Calculator — What You Keep After 10.75% Commission and the $0.30 Order Fee
entry.summary: Free TCGplayer seller fee calculator: 10.75% marketplace commission (capped at $75 per product, charged on cards plus shipping) and 2.5% + $0.30 per-order transaction fee. See your payout, profit per order, the price for a target profit, and Pro or pre-February-2026 rates side by side. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Youth Lineup Rotator — fair playing time for every kid, free
entry.summary: Free youth sports lineup generator for volunteer coaches. Equal playing time, nobody benched twice in a row, goalkeeper turns shared, subs planned per period. Soccer, basketball, hockey and more. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: GitHub Actions Schedule Cron Check — Invalid, Too-Frequent and Top-of-Hour Crons
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every schedule cron that is invalid, faster than GitHub's 5-minute minimum, or pinned to the top of the hour where scheduled runs get delayed. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Financial Aid Award Letter Comparator — true cost of each college offer
entry.summary: Free financial aid award letter comparator. Type in each college's cost, grants, loans and work-study and see the true four-year cost, loans repaid with interest, the year-2 price jump and the grant that would match the cheapest offer. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: JWT Security Check — decode a token and find misconfigurations
entry.summary: Paste a JWT and get its header and payload decoded, plus every common security misconfiguration flagged: alg:none, embedded jwk/jku/x5u/x5c key material, symmetric-vs-asymmetric algorithm confusion, a kid header shaped like path traversal or SQL injection, missing/excessive exp, and sensitive-looking fields in the unencrypted payload. Free JWT decoder and security checker, runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Review Reply Desk — free Google review reply generator for local businesses
entry.summary: Free review response generator. Paste your Google, Yelp or Facebook reviews and get a ready-to-post reply to each one: rating-aware, specific, safe around legal, health-privacy and refund traps, and checked before you post. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: S-Corp Shareholder Basis Tracker — stock basis, debt basis and Form 7203 worksheet
entry.summary: Free S corporation shareholder basis calculator. Enter each year's K-1 figures and get stock basis, debt basis and suspended losses carried forward in Form 7203 order, with taxable excess distributions flagged. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Sales Call Notes Desk — turn call notes into CRM fields and a follow-up email, free
entry.summary: Free sales call notes to CRM tool. Paste your notes or transcript and get the CRM fields, what BANT and MEDDIC still miss, dated next steps and a checked follow-up email. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Survey Keeper — Self-Hosted NPS and Surveys, a Typeform and Delighted Alternative
entry.summary: Run surveys and Net Promoter Score on a server you own: NPS with a 95% range, the words detractors use, results by source, CSV export and an alert on every detractor. Open source, MIT, no per-response fee. Try the NPS calculator in your browser.

entry.title: GitHub Actions Runtime Deprecation Check — Find Steps on End-of-Life Node Runtimes
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and list every actions/* step pinned to a major that runs on a deprecated Node runtime (Node 12 or 16) or that GitHub has shut down. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Changelog Keeper — Free Self-Hosted Changelog, Release Notes Page and What's New Widget
entry.summary: Publish product updates on a public changelog page with Atom and JSON feeds and an embeddable What's new bell with an unread badge. Scheduled posts, drafts, Slack webhook. Open source, MIT, one-click self-deploy, no monthly fee.

entry.title: Churn Radar — Free Self-Hosted Churn Prediction for SaaS
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to ChurnZero and Gainsight for small SaaS: learn from your own usage events which accounts are about to cancel, with an honest out-of-time accuracy check. Paste an export and try it in your browser first.

entry.title: Deal Keeper — Free Self-Hosted Sales Forecast and Pipeline Hygiene
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to the forecasting add-ons of Pipedrive, HubSpot and Clari for small B2B teams: win chances learned from your own closed deals, a backtested forecast range and a ranked list of stale or slipping deals. Paste a deal export and try it in your browser.

entry.title: devsec-toolkit — Every DevSecOps Check in One Free, Open-Source Command
entry.summary: One zero-dependency command that runs your repository through 23 open-source DevSecOps checks: GitHub Actions injection and poisoning, Docker and Compose, Kubernetes, dependency confusion, JWT misuse, ReDoS, AI-agent permissions. One report, SARIF for code scanning, baselines. MIT licensed, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Error Keeper — Free Self-Hosted Error Tracking (Sentry Alternative)
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to Sentry and Rollbar for small teams: groups the same bug together, alerts on new errors, regressions and spikes, one Node process and one JSON file. Paste stack traces and see the grouping in your browser first.

entry.title: Help Keeper — Self-Hosted Help Center, a Help Scout Docs Alternative
entry.summary: A help center you host yourself: Markdown articles, typo-tolerant ranked search, helpful votes and a report of what visitors searched for and could not find. Open source, MIT, no per-seat fee. Try the search in your browser.

entry.title: ICP Lens — Free Ideal Customer Profile Builder and Lead Scorer
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to lead-scoring add-ons: learn your ideal customer profile from your own won and lost list, rank your prospects by lookalike fit with a leave-one-out accuracy check, and draft compliant first outreach on your own AI key. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Internal Link Planner — Find Orphan Pages and Missing Internal Links
entry.summary: Free internal link audit and planner. Drop in your site's HTML files: it finds orphan pages and pages linked only from menus, then suggests the exact sentences in your other pages that should link to them, with the link-equity gain. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Liability Audit — Scan Your App for Legal and Financial Exposure (Trackers, Auto-Renew, Leaked Keys, Uncapped AI Spend)
entry.summary: Free, open-source scan of your app's code or built site for legal and financial exposure: trackers with no consent, subscriptions with no renewal terms, a missing privacy policy or terms, affiliate links with no disclosure, AI with no disclosure, live keys in the tree, LLM endpoints with no spend cap, and cloud IaC with no budget alarm. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
